title: Celebrate Survive Behavior
description: Allows this entity to celebrate surviving a raid by shooting fireworks.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: The duration in seconds that the celebration lasts for.

fireworks_interval.title: Fireworks Interval
fireworks_interval.description: Minimum and maximum time between firework (positive, in seconds).

on_celebration_end_event.title: Celebration End Event
on_celebration_end_event.description: The event to trigger when the goal's duration expires.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.
